optionAnalysis.reason: True: with unary encoding the input length is at least $W$.
False (the required answer): $W$ is exponential in its binary length.
True: the chosen subset is a polynomial-time verifiable certificate.
True: subset-sum is NP-complete.

pitfalls: Treating $O(nW)$ as polynomial because it looks like a product of two input quantities.
cse-2008-cs-44.verification: If (B) were true, an NP-complete problem would be in P, implying P = NP.
